note.zh-TW: 模板的營業外收入包含利息收入、處分利益等，範圍比台灣報表的「其他收入」廣。
note.en: The template line covers interest income, disposal gains and similar items, so it is broader than the other income line in Taiwanese statements.

definition.zh-TW: 本業以外的收入，例如利息收入或處分資產的利益。模板裡是可以輸入的一列；本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: Income from outside the main business, such as interest income or gains on disposal of assets. An input line in the template; the course story does not use it.
